clue.text: Remove diamonds: make engraved design without one

parts.note: D is the card-suit abbreviation for diamonds

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the engraving word goes round the letter for one

parts.note: to etch is to engrave a design with acid
A means one, as in 'a pound'

explanation.surface: A jeweller's instruction: take the diamonds out, then engrave the setting without one of them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside, not lacking: ETCH sits around A, and D goes in front.
explanation.definitionFit: To detach something is to unfasten and take it away, a straight synonym of removing it.

clue.text: Escape allowed no return, after turning over military cop

indicators.note: after means the policeman comes after the flipped word
turning over means the tennis word is flipped to read backwards

parts.note: in tennis, a serve that is aced allows the opponent no return
MP is a military policeman

explanation.surface: A prisoner escapes, unable to go back, after overpowering a military policeman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no return' reads like a one-way escape, but it is tennis: an ace is a serve the opponent cannot get back. 'turning over' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: To decamp is to leave suddenly or secretly, to make off, which is to escape.

clue.text: Jail sentence before court case? That's a measure of speed

indicators.note: before means the sentence comes first in the answer

parts.note: doing time is serving a prison sentence
a trial is a case heard in court

explanation.surface: A prison term ahead of the hearing: a gauge of how swift justice is?
explanation.definitionFit: A time trial is a race against the clock, used in cycling to gauge a rider's pace.

clue.text: Deception that's brought about defeat? One's in the soup

indicators.note: brought about means placed around the next piece

parts.note: a con is a trick or swindle
a rout is a heavy defeat

explanation.surface: A trick that caused a loss leaves someone in the soup, in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the soup' looks like the idiom for trouble but is literal: a crouton floats in soup.
explanation.definitionFit: A crouton is a small cube of fried or toasted bread served floating in soup.

clue.text: Historic recordings including one's poem and other passages

indicators.note: including means the recordings hold the next pieces inside them

parts.note: EPs, extended-play records, are a format of the past
one is I, so one's is I'S, written IS
an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: Old records featuring someone's poem along with other extracts.
explanation.walkthrough: In a fugue (a kind of 10, COMPOSITION) the episodes are the passages other than the main statements of the subject.
explanation.definitionFit: In musical form, episodes are the linking sections between statements of the main theme, so they are the other passages.

clue.text: They go to stir providing stir provisions, possibly

indicators.note: possibly means these letters might form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: People who visit prison, perhaps bringing supplies for inmates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stir' is slang for prison.
explanation.definitionFit: Prison visitors are people who call on inmates in jail, which is going to stir.

clue.text: 10s very much upset the Devil

parts.note: so means very much, as in 'so kind'

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the Devil's name reads from bottom to top

parts.note: Satan is the Devil

explanation.surface: Compositions that greatly upset the Devil, who has the best tunes.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 is COMPOSITION.
explanation.definitionFit: Sonatas are instrumental compositions, usually in several movements, for a soloist or small group.

clue.text: Hot, entering food shop in Asian capital

indicators.note: entering means the letter goes into the shop word

parts.note: a deli is a delicatessen
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Heat coming into a food shop in an Asian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Delhi, strictly New Delhi, is the capital city of India.

clue.text: Picked up my source of solace: unreal 10

indicators.note: source of means the first letter of the next word
picked up in a down clue means lifted to read upwards, so the word is backwards

parts.note: taken as written
phony means fake, not real

explanation.surface: Someone collects their comfort and finds it is a false composition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Picked up' suggests a homophone, but it reverses MY to YM. 10 is COMPOSITION.
explanation.definitionFit: A symphony is a large orchestral composition, usually in four movements.

clue.text: Endured billowy clouds where the USAF fly?

indicators.note: clouds as a verb means muddles, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Billowing clouds were endured where American air force planes fly.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase comes from the US Air Force song 'Off we go into the wild blue yonder'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a poetic name for the distant sky, made famous by the US Air Force anthem.

clue.text: Ingredients in Communist stance

parts.note: Com is an abbreviation for Communist
a stance is a position taken on an issue

explanation.surface: A look at what goes into the Communist stance on something.
explanation.definitionFit: The composition of something is its make-up, the ingredients it consists of.

clue.text: Batter not entirely poor in quality

indicators.note: not entirely means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a lame excuse is a weak, poor one

explanation.surface: A cook's verdict: this batter is not wholly up to standard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Batter' looks like the cooking mixture but is the verb to beat.
explanation.definitionFit: To lam is an informal verb for thrashing someone, the same as to batter them.

clue.text: 10, small piece, with third element repeated

parts.note: a mote is a tiny speck or particle
the third letter of the small piece, T, is written again at the end

explanation.surface: Bare mechanism: a small piece whose third element is repeated.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 is COMPOSITION, so the definition is a musical composition.
explanation.definitionFit: A motet is a short choral composition, usually sacred, so it is one kind of musical piece.

clue.text: Spa town right for Parisian enchantress, we hear

parts.note: droit is French for right

indicators.note: we hear means the next word is given by how it is spoken

parts.note: a witch is a woman who casts spells

explanation.surface: A Paris visitor describes a sorceress as fitting a spa town, by repute.
explanation.walkthrough: DROITWICH is a spa town in Worcestershire, England, known for its brine baths.
explanation.definitionFit: Droitwich Spa is the town's full name, a place famed for salt-water bathing.

clue.text: Skirt: worked at including navy length

indicators.note: including means the first word takes the next letters inside it

parts.note: to do a task is to work at it, so did means worked at
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A seamstress made a skirt, adding naval detail and length.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirndl is a full, gathered Alpine-style skirt from traditional peasant dress.

clue.text: Gave son rocks from French mountains

indicators.note: rocks as a verb means shakes up, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone gave their son stones brought back from the French mountains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rocks' looks like the gift itself but is the verb signalling a shuffle of GAVE SON.
explanation.definitionFit: The Vosges are a mountain range in eastern France; this adjective describes things belonging to them.

clue.text: English daunted about start of rubbish Aussie's prattled

indicators.note: about means the daunted word goes round the next letter

parts.note: abashed means embarrassed or disconcerted

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: An abashed Englishman complains that an Australian has been talking rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads 'Aussie has prattled': the word is Australian slang.
explanation.definitionFit: In Australian slang, to earbash is to talk at length, so the past form means talked on and on.

clue.text: 10, something definite in company? Definitely not!

indicators.note: in means the certainty is placed within the other letters

parts.note: no is an emphatic refusal
a cert is a certainty, a sure thing

explanation.surface: Is the composition a sure thing among company? Absolutely not!
explanation.walkthrough: CERT goes inside CONO, splitting it after CON. 10 is COMPOSITION.
explanation.definitionFit: A concerto is a composition for a solo instrument accompanied by an orchestra.

clue.text: Indirect treatment of boil — quite free of it?

indicators.note: treatment of means the following word is worked over into a new order
free of means the given word is removed from the other

explanation.surface: An oblique cure for a boil, leaving the patient entirely free of it?
explanation.walkthrough: 'treatment of' rearranges BOIL to OBLI; 'free of' takes IT from QUITE to leave QUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Oblique means not straight or direct, so it is a synonym of indirect.

clue.text: Peaceful, yielding one to skill in 10

indicators.note: yielding one to means the letter for one gives way to the next word

parts.note: quiet means calm and peaceful
art means skill, as in the art of persuasion

explanation.surface: A calm player hands over to someone with skill in a piece of music.
explanation.walkthrough: One is I, swapped for ART. 10 is COMPOSITION.
explanation.definitionFit: A quartet is a piece written for four performers, such as a string quartet.

clue.text: Excellent bird not included in big game in US?

indicators.note: not included means the bird is taken out of the game's name

parts.note: the Super Bowl is the American football championship game
an owl is a bird

explanation.surface: A splendid bird left out of a hunting trip in America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'big game' suggests hunting; it is the Super Bowl, the NFL final.
explanation.definitionFit: Superb is a direct synonym of excellent, describing something of the highest quality.

clue.text: Roman site: splendour that is uplifting around capital of Italy

parts.note: pomp is ceremonial splendour

indicators.note: around means the flipped letters go round the next letter
uplifting in a down clue means raised up, so the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: i.e., id est, means that is

indicators.note: capital of means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: An uplifting, splendid Roman site around the heart of Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uplifting' turns IE to EI, which goes round I.
explanation.definitionFit: Pompeii is the Roman town near Naples buried by Vesuvius in AD 79, now an excavated ruin.

clue.text: Meal notes included in long recipe, initially

indicators.note: included in means the notes go inside the word for long

parts.note: to be dying for something is to long for it, so die means long
nn. is the abbreviation for notes, as in footnotes

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: A meal written up with notes in a lengthy recipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'notes' suggests musical letters, but it is NN, the plural abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Dinner is the main meal of the day, eaten in the evening or at midday.

clue.text: Happen to turn?

definitions.meaning: in sailing, a vessel changes tack by swinging round onto the other side

explanation.surface: A query about whether something will happen to change direction.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to occur and, for a sailing ship, to tack round onto a new course.

clue.text: Possibly erected some sculpture by a man

indicators.note: erected says the hidden letters are read backwards
some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Perhaps a statue by a man has been put up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'erected' in a down clue reads the hidden EBYAM upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Maybe is an adverb of uncertainty, an everyday synonym of perhaps.

clue.text: Heroine of 10 seen around a US city

indicators.note: seen around means the heroine's name is placed round the letter

parts.note: Mimi is the heroine of Puccini's opera La Bohème, a musical composition

explanation.surface: An opera heroine spotted near an American city.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 is COMPOSITION; Puccini's La Bohème is the work meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Miami is a large city in Florida, in the United States.

clue.text: River always supplying fish

parts.note: R is the map abbreviation for river
ay, or aye, is an old word for always

explanation.surface: A river that never fails to provide fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A ray is a flat cartilaginous sea fish with wing-like fins, such as the skate.

clue.text: Bounder that rebuilt in sixteenth century style

indicators.note: rebuilt means the letters are put together again in another order

explanation.surface: A cad has had his house rebuilt in a period style.
explanation.definitionFit: Tudorbethan is a jokey name for architecture imitating the Tudor and Elizabethan buildings of the 1500s.

clue.text: 10, clear and clean, without piano

parts.note: overt means open, plain to see

indicators.note: without means the letter is dropped from the word for clean

parts.note: pure means clean, unpolluted
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A composition described as clear and clean, with no piano part.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 is COMPOSITION.
explanation.definitionFit: An overture is an orchestral piece that opens an opera or stands alone as a concert work.

clue.text: Important violinist audible in 10s

indicators.note: audible means the word is given by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: the leader of an orchestra is its principal first violinist

explanation.surface: The orchestra's top violinist can be heard in some compositions.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 is COMPOSITION, so 10s are compositions.
explanation.definitionFit: Lieder are German art songs, such as those of Schubert, a body of vocal compositions.
